nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as privileged address in the pooladdress modifier, allowing the owner to bypass all transfer restrictions.
Public mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated directly in transferFrom with unchecked arithmetic.
Public nested mapping of allowances; set in approve and decremented in transferFrom when msg.sender is not the spender-approved owner.
Total supply of the token, assigned once in the constructor from the _supply argument.
Hard-coded constant address of the Uniswap V2 router (0x7a25...488D); gets an unlimited allowance from the deployer in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, FINANCE, _value); payable with no value handling.
Core transfer logic guarded by the pooladdress modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance decrements and increments and emits Transfer.
Public payable approval function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race-condition protection.
Modifier that computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires FARM == owner OR FINANCE == owner OR FARM == liquiditypool; this is the honeypot access-control gate.
Internal pure function deriving the Uniswap V2 pair address for the hardcoded factory and WETH, using a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets name/symbol/supply, records owner = msg.sender, mints the whole supply to the deployer and pre-approves the UNI router with uint(-1).
Caller-controlled address used as the from/spender in transfer, transferFrom and approve, and as the owner assignment in the constructor.
allowance[FARM][msg.sender] -= _value executed with raw Solidity 0.5 arithmetic (no SafeMath); only guarded by require(allowance >= _value).
balanceOf[FARM] -= _value performed without SafeMath under Solidity 0.5, guarded only by require(balanceOf[FARM] >= _value).
balanceOf[FINANCE] += _value performed without SafeMath; recipient balance can silently overflow the 2^256 bound.
require(FARM == owner || FINANCE == owner || FARM == liquiditypool) inside the modifier: a hidden owner backdoor that lets the owner move any holder's tokens and blocks ordinary users from selling.
Destination address argument of transfer, forwarded as the recipient of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address argument of transferFrom; checked by the pooladdress modifier and debited from balanceOf/allowance.
Destination address argument of transferFrom; credited in balanceOf and checked by the pooladdress modifier.
Amount argument of transferFrom; used in the allowance check/decrement and the balance debit/credit.
Spender address argument of approve; index into the allowance mapping.
Approval amount argument of approve; written directly into allowance.
FARM address captured by the modifier from transferFrom; compared against owner and liquiditypool.
FINANCE address captured by the modifier from transferFrom; compared against owner.
Factory address argument of pairFor, supplied as the hardcoded Uniswap V2 factory.
First token address argument of pairFor; ordered against tokenB.
Second token address argument of pairFor; ordered against tokenA.
Token name assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
Token symbol assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
Initial supply assigned to totalSupply and to the deployer balance in the constructor.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address for this token used in the modifier's require condition.
Lexicographically smaller of tokenA/tokenB, part of the pair salt computation.
Lexicographically larger of tokenA/tokenB, part of the pair salt computation.
Computed CREATE2-style pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the source address into transferFrom when transfer is called.

_value amount argument flows from transfer into the delegated transferFrom call.
FARM source argument indexes allowance/balanceOf inside transferFrom.
FINANCE destination argument indexes balanceOf inside transferFrom.
_value amount is used in the allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
_spender argument indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value argument is written into allowance[msg.sender][_spender].

_value is subtracted from allowance[FARM][msg.sender] without SafeMath.

_value is subtracted from balanceOf[FARM] without SafeMath.

_value is added to balanceOf[FINANCE] without SafeMath.
allowance mapping is read and written by the unchecked decrement operation.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by the unchecked decrement operation.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by the unchecked increment operation.

The modifier invokes pairFor to derive the liquidity pool address.

tokenB may be assigned to local token1 during the ordering ternary.

normalization_plan.reason: FINANCE is only a formal argument of transfer and carries no independent semantics.
_value is only a formal argument of transfer and should collapse into the function node.
FARM is a formal argument of transferFrom used solely for allowance/balance indexing.
FINANCE is a formal argument of transferFrom used solely for balance crediting.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance increment and belongs with that unsafe operation.
_spender is a formal argument of approve used only as an allowance index.
_value is a formal argument of approve written directly into allowance.
FARM is the value tested by the modifier's access-control require.
FINANCE is the value tested by the modifier's access-control require.
factory is a formal argument of pairFor used only inside the hash computation.
tokenA is a formal argument of pairFor used only for token ordering.
tokenB is a formal argument of pairFor used only for token ordering.
_name is a constructor argument assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is a constructor argument assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply is a constructor argument assigned to totalSupply and the deployer balance.
liquiditypool is a temporary local inside the modifier feeding its require.
token0 is an intermediate ordering variable local to pairFor.
token1 is an intermediate ordering variable local to pairFor.
pair is the return value local of pairFor and has no standalone meaning.
